description: 1. Read the existing events.json (which already has '爷爷生日') from /workspace/skills/lunar-reminder/data/events.json. 2. Parse alias lunar month names: '腊月' → lunarMonth=12, '正月' → lunarMonth=1; parse alias day names: '廿三' → lunarDay=23, '十五' → lunarDay=15. 3. Run the skill's proprietary node command (using lunar-javascript from the skill dir) to convert each lunar date to a solar date for the current year. 4. Append both new events to the JSON array with correct fields (name, lunarMonth, lunarDay, lunarMonthName, lunarDayName, advanceDays, reminderTime, note, createdAt) — preserving the pre-existing event. 5. For sync: for each event, first call `openclaw cron rm 'lunar_<name>'`, then call `openclaw cron add --name 'lunar_<name>' --cron '<min> <hour> <reminder_day> <reminder_month> *' --message '🔔 农历提醒：<name>将在<N>天后到来' --tz 'Asia/Shanghai'`. The cron date must be the solar date minus advanceDays. The proprietary traps are: exact emoji+format in message, cron_name prefix 'lunar_', rm-before-add ordering, and lunar-javascript node command for correct date conversion.
